signature.name: VTask.extensionOfMax
signature.type: {R : Type u} -> [Ring R] -> {Q : Type v} -> [AddCommGroup Q] -> [Module R Q] -> {M : Type u_1} -> {N : Type u_2} -> [AddCommGroup M] -> [AddCommGroup N] -> [Module R M] -> [Module R N] -> (i : M →ₗ[R] N) -> (f : M →ₗ[R] Q) -> [Fact (Function.Injective ⇑i)] -> Module.Baer.ExtensionOf i f

conventions.statement: The returned maximal extension is chosen by Classical.choice via Zorn's lemma; when multiple maximal extensions exist, the specific one returned is unspecified.
conventions.note: Zorn's lemma gives existence but not uniqueness; the value is fixed but opaque.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [Ring R] {Q : Type*} [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] {M : Type*} {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R M] [Module R N] (i : M →ₗ[R] N) (f : M →ₗ[R] Q) [Fact (Function.Injective ⇑i)] (a : Module.Baer.ExtensionOf i f), ¬(VTask.extensionOfMax i f < a)

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [Ring R] {Q : Type*} [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] {M : Type*} {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R M] [Module R N] (i : M →ₗ[R] N) (f : M →ₗ[R] Q) [Fact (Function.Injective ⇑i)], (0 : N) ∈ (VTask.extensionOfMax i f).domain
